description: AC-33: Files permitted to INSERT directly into proposal_transition_ledger after mig 311 enforcement. These are test fixtures only. Production code paths are NOT permitted here. Each exemption must be reviewed before mig 311 is applied — test files should be migrated to call fn_canonical_transition_insert() via the canonicalTransition() TypeScript wrapper wherever possible.

exemptions.reason: DB-4/DB-5 live tests call fn_canonical_transition_insert() via SQL SELECT — not a direct INSERT. No exemption required for post-311 test runs. Fixture teardown uses DELETE (admin superuser, not revoked for admin).

DB-1 (trigger shadow-write test) inserts into proposal_state_transitions (PST), not directly into proposal_transition_ledger. The shadow trigger fn_shadow_write_to_ledger() (SECURITY DEFINER) performs the ledger write. No direct ledger INSERT from test code.
Tests for enforcement itself; all writes go through fn_canonical_transition_insert() or via PST+shadow-trigger. Direct INSERT is tested only as a negative case (expect permission denied).

notes: If a file is added here with requires_direct_insert=true, it MUST use a superuser/admin connection (not application roles) and MUST rollback the transaction.
All test files that needed direct INSERT were migrated to use fn_canonical_transition_insert() before mig 311 enforcement was applied.
